davideimola/go-security-skills.name: go-security-audit
davideimola/go-security-skills.description: Security audit of a Go repo or service. Use when the user asks to audit or check the security of Go code, or whether its dependencies or Go version have known vulnerabilities.

davideimola/go-security-skills.name: go-security-setup
davideimola/go-security-skills.description: Go security CI setup for a Go repo. Use when the user wants security CI set up in a Go repo (govulncheck, fuzzing, Dependabot, a patched toolchain, a security policy), or its schedule, fuzzing or failure policy changed, or where the audit gets govulncheck and gosec from.

davideimola/go-security-skills.name: verify-with-fuzz
davideimola/go-security-skills.description: Verifies a security hypothesis about Go code by writing a fuzz property and named test cases that fail on today's code and stay as regression tests. Use when the user suspects an authorization or trust bug in Go code (who may do what, which input is trusted) and wants it proven with a failing test, or when go-security-audit needs evidence for a logic finding.

davideimola/skills.name: idea
davideimola/skills.description: Capture a raw content spark as an idea note in Davide's Trilium Inbox, from any repo. Use when Davide wants to jot down a content idea or spark and file it fast — capture first, judge later.

davideimola/skills.name: tweets
davideimola/skills.description: Propose a few short posts for Davide's X + Bluesky queue from what he already makes (Trilium ideas, blog posts, Argus activity, upcoming talks), then save the approved ones as planned drafts in Typefully. Use when Davide wants tweets, short posts, or to fill the queue ("proponimi dei tweet", "riempi la coda", "/tweets"), from any repo.
